beats.say: Fans, your favourite science fiction franchise is getting a fresh sequel this week.
Aaron Guzikowski is penning the new Alien script for 20th Century Studios. The writer is known for his work on sci‑fi thrillers.
Ridley Scott will produce, ensuring the classic horror vibe returns. His involvement promises the tension fans love.
The story links to the 2010s prequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant. Those films explored humanity’s first contact with the Xenomorph.
Which alien terror will haunt your nights? Stay tuned for the reveal later this year.
